starts.name: Icon
starts.note: The default: a saint and a board, one chip high, one low, buses into the shoulders.

starts.name: Altarpiece
starts.note: Bilateral board, flanking chips, octagon halo with guard rings. Ritual symmetry; the only flaw is in the robe.

starts.name: Routed
starts.note: The cloth is gone: the robe is ridges bending at 45 degrees. The figure is the board.

starts.name: Taken
starts.note: The machine eats upward from the hem, in blocks. Parts move into the holes it leaves.

starts.name: Half
starts.note: One side of the saint gone to circuit. The face holds.

starts.name: Silicon face
starts.note: Where the face should be, a bare die bonded to the mask. No features: a god with a floorplan.

starts.name: Absent
starts.note: A blank mask with lit eyes in the accent pen. One live net runs from a chip to the robe.

starts.name: Mandorla
starts.note: The rays leave the whole body: a small figure in a full turn of wires, the board pushed to the corners.

starts.name: Colossus
starts.note: Too big for the sheet: head and shoulders fill it, no halo, coarse ridges. The board is what is left at the edges.

starts.name: Off axis
starts.note: The figure a third of the way in, head tilted, one great chip filling the open side. The asymmetric one.

starts.name: Lost sync
starts.note: The face slipping, scanlines on a diagonal, a third eye. Silver saint on a gold board.

starts.name: Sleeper
starts.note: Eyes closed, a long neck and a narrow column for a body. Quiet board, wide keep-out: the most paper.
